## Changes

- Rebuilt revolved exterior from visible source contours; interior follows the exterior with an explicit wall thickness
- Thin transparent shell, IOR 1.5, thick manufactured foot and rounded lip
- Added the clear loop visible through the front tall glass as a thin transparent handle with 16 graspable convex contact segments; its partly hidden angular position is inferred from the three source views
- Remeasured observed depth surfaces in three calibrated frames
- Re-fitted metric placement, scale, tilt and nesting spacing against fixed cameras
- Computed mass, COM and per-instance inertia from closed shell volumes and material densities

Supplemental all-instance evidence: [three-view comparison](../review/straight_tumbler_instances_compare.jpg). Visual source/render/overlay review of count, type, visible rim and contact alignment; supplemental landmark fits where recorded. This does not supply a separate silhouette IoU for every instance.

## Material, contact and physics

Empty canonical asset mass: **0.2445 kg**, from closed physical shell volumes and per-part densities. No manufacturer product identification or scale measurement is available. The stored ±30% range is a nominal engineering prior, not a confidence interval. Scale and unobserved wall-thickness uncertainty may be larger. Material: soda-lime glass; friction 0.4; restitution 0.05; fragile `True`. Per-instance masses, mass-weighted COM and inertia use each variant, scale and retained part state.

| Physical part | Density kg/m³ | Mass kg | Canonical COM m |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| body | 2500 | 0.24447 | [-0.0, 0.0, 0.05454] |

33 convex contacts follow the floor, segmented thin walls, handles/stems and separate closure parts. They preserve vessel cavities; they are not a liquid boundary. Convexity, watertightness and open-axis checks passed. The individual upright 2-second Blender settling check passed. These checks do not certify assembled stacking, rack hanging, robot grasping, fracture, or friction accuracy.

Joints: `[]`. Detachable parts: `[]`. Rigid vessel; detachable lids/strainers, when listed, remain independent bodies.

Reusable variants: [handled_glass](variants/handled_glass/model.json). Prototype files have no independent inventory instances; the parent instance table owns placements.

## Appearance and reproducibility

Glass uses physical transmission, IOR 1.5 and thin inner/outer walls. Glaze and metal parameters are stored in `material_parameters`; they are material priors, not measured BRDFs. Photo rebakes and inferred generated details are documented in [texture provenance](../review/round2_texture_provenance.json). No source object image is inserted into a glass shader or review background. Bounded exposure/white-balance fitting is in-sample, using the same review frames. The offline renderer records actual wall times, sample count, resolution and denoising under `review/`.

Build this asset with `QA_FAST=1 blender -b -P build.py`. Run the set-level `round2_render.py -- straight_tumbler`, `round2_physics.py`, and `round2_report.py` for calibrated reviews and metadata. `model.glb` is visual geometry; simulation importers must also read the JSON joints and compound collision files.
